summary: AstraZeneca PLC furnished a Form 6-K disclosing a PDMR share purchase under the UK Market Abuse Regulation, the US-equivalent insider-transaction disclosure. CEO Pascal Soriot bought 60,000 ordinary shares of $0.25 each on 14 September 2026 at GB 121.02 per share, roughly GBP 7.26 million, executed on the London Stock Exchange; notification to the company occurred 16 September and the filing is dated 18 September 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms apply. This is a routine insider-buying disclosure, not a special situation; watch for follow-on PDMR filings or any change in executive ownership.
